# SlotBot

> SlotBot is a Schengen visa appointment service. It monitors visa centre slots (TLScontact, VFS, BLS) every 60 seconds from the UK and UAE and either notifies you instantly when a slot opens or books it for you. Notifications start from £35. Autobooking is £89 per applicant, visa centre fees included. Contact: WhatsApp +44 7747 339349.

SlotBot is a private service. It is not affiliated with any consulate, embassy or official visa centre and cannot influence visa decisions.

- [Home](https://slotbot.uk/): services, pricing and FAQ
- [What is SlotBot](https://slotbot.uk/blog/what-is-slotbot.html): how the service works
